paragraphs.text:
You follow the kid into the alley.
He is being harassed by a group
of mean looking teens wearing
creepy Halloween masks. They
circle him and shove him off
balance. As you intervene to stop
the bullies, they turn to you,
hissing “He was one of us and he
went away. Now he has to pay!”
You may leave the kid to this
company of delinquent youths (go
back to your exploration of the
town) or ask that they leave him
alone (go to #32).
